title: Coefficient differential term of signed localized Koszul evaluation
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, f:Fin(r)→A, and F an arbitrary integer cochain complex of module sheaves on Spec(A) [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Let J be nonempty, p=|J|-1, q=n-p, a_J=prod(j in J) f(j), and S(p,n)=p*(n-p)+p*(p-1)/2. On sections over D(a_J), let D_(S,a_J,e+1) be the inverse of scalar multiplication by a_J^(e+1). For every x in Γ(Spec(A),F^q), signed localized restriction of d_F(x), with sign (-1)^S(p,n+1), equals (-1)^p d_F applied to signed localized restriction of x, with sign (-1)^S(p,n). The unsigned division and signed degree maps [def-sc-module-total-hom-complex, def-sc-koszul-open-system, def-sc-principal-open-alternating-total] are the existing concrete definitions, relocated without changes.

source.place: Stacks Project Tags 08D0 and 08D1, read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08D0 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08D1; fraction differential calculation and coefficient naturality with totalization signs.

proof.text: Restriction is natural for every coefficient sheaf morphism. Multiplication by the principal product commutes with A-linear section maps. Apply the scalar equivalence inverse injectivity to deduce that its inverse also commutes with them.
Expand S(p,n+1)=S(p,n)+p by ring arithmetic. negOnePow_add and cast_negOnePow_natCast identify the extra factor with (-1)^p. Linearity moves the old sign through d_F.
